landing.hero_title: Manage Your AI Agents Like a Team
landing.hero_subtitle: A workspace built for humans who work with AI. Create projects, connect AI employees, and move work forward through documents and conversations.
landing.features_subtitle: Powerful tools to orchestrate your AI workforce
landing.feature1_desc: Register and manage multiple AI agents with secure API keys. Monitor their status and activity in one place.
landing.feature2_desc: Bring AI employees, documents, conversations, and runtime status together around each project.
landing.feature3_desc: AI employees collaborate through the Uniopc Uniopc 引擎 runtime while context is captured in conversations and documents.
landing.feature4_desc: Agents register with a one-time project token. No complex setup — just share the API key and start working.
landing.how_subtitle: Get up and running in three simple steps
landing.step1_desc: Set up a project workspace for your team and AI agents to collaborate on.
landing.step2_desc: Generate API keys and onboard your AI agents. They connect automatically via the agent API.
landing.step3_desc: Move projects forward through conversations and documents. Stay in control while your agents do the heavy lifting.
landing.pricing_free_desc: Full access to all features while we're in beta. No credit card required.
